page.overview:
Who is Guardian Pillar?

The Guardian Pillar is a fictional avatar created by Chaosium for the role-playing game Call of Cthulhu. It is loosely inspired by the description of the Elder Gods in "The Lair of the Star-Spawn", by August Derleth and Mark Schorer, as well as the "pillar of flame" featured in The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath, by H. P. Lovecraft.

The Guardian Pillar is a living flame, identified as an avatar of the Elder Gods, which dwells in the Cavern of Flame with the bearded priests Nasht and Kaman-Thah. It guards the gates to the Dreamlands, and enables Nasht and Kaman-Thah to contact the Great Ones, which are the only beings capable of commanding the Guardian Pillar to leave the Cavern of Flame. (: H. P. Lovecraft's Dreamlands)

The portrayal of the Guardian Pillar as an avatar of the Elder Gods, which is controlled by the Great Ones might be a reference to the Dreamlands stories penned by Gary Myers, in which the Elder Gods and the Great Ones are actually the same species. However, this interpretation is not supported by the Call of Cthulhu RPG in general. In most iterations of the Mythos, the Great Ones are protected by the Elder Gods' enemies, the Outer Gods. Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Extra-Dimensional Characters Category:Avatars
